source_or_gap: Six worked decisions and four shorter comparisons from eleven papers, with reader counterparts.
chapter_action_policy: Six worked decisions and four shorter comparisons from eleven papers, with reader counterparts.
boundary_decision_rationale: Each study changes the interpretation of an existing decision or measurement.
external_literature_need: Retained leads from the November 18 screen: optimizer-state staleness (2603.16731v2), prefix-normalized policy optimization (2608.01418v1), adaptive targeted dynamic chunking (2605.30080v1), trajectory-based data influence (2608.13515v1), prospective data curation (2611.19698v1), and information disclosure in agent markets (2611.07667v1). Candidate uses and limits are recorded in docs/reader_manuscript_review.md.
proof_or_test_backlog: Adoption requires a comparison under the intended load, budget, user population or update schedule.
evidence_transition_precondition: Adoption or stronger capability claims require the appropriate matched comparison and an accepted evidence transition.
required_before_drafting: Review the primary passage and the comparison limits before using the result.
promotion_blockers: Results describe the cited setups, including the declared measurement and population.
residuals: Instance regressions depend on the grading criterion, versions and task.
The dataset contains mathematics statements. Human audit found some faithful translations among the rejections.
The tasks use synthesized, explicit disclosure constraints and single-agent environments.
Credibility and trust ratings on the studied previews do not measure historical caption accuracy.
The experiment measured reactions to particular media and provenance displays.
The comparisons concern whole-model inference services with particular rosters, prices and tasks.
The metadata audit does not decide permissions for an individual use of a particular artifact.
Judgments reflect a particular online community. Representing a distribution supplies no authority to decide for that community.
The inference study does not establish cross-hardware identity or reproduction of external tool effects.
The guarantee assumes exchangeability within the pattern. The study did not measure deployment acquisition drift.
Inference for the target population needs suitable measured selection factors and positive inclusion probabilities.
next_action: Revisit cited results when their benchmark or manuscript changes.
non_claims: Worked examples are editorial applications. Published results provide contextual evidence.
